title: Switch to using uber/npm-shrinkwrap
body:
npm shrinkwrap is broken in many ways, [uber/npm-shrinkwrap](https://github.com/uber/npm-shrinkwrap) seems: promising, well maintained

Let's give it a try.

TODO:

If this works that's great because we can then switch to npm@3 without worrying about shrinkwrap.
